description: Reference-verifier conformance suite (SDD §5). Every runtime port runs each case and must produce exactly `expected`.

cases.description: Three chained entries; NFD payload string, IEEE-754 edge numbers, optional fields absent.
Entry 1 payload edited after hashing; content phase fails at index 1.
Entry 2 previous_hash does not link to entry 1; chain phase fails at index 2.
genesis_hash differs from entry 0 previous_hash; chain phase fails at index 0.
No entries; trivially valid.
Signature over safeCanonicalize(envelope minus signature); wire strings are NFD, signing input is NFC.
One body field changed after signing.
Valid envelope checked against a different public key.
Signature value is not ed25519: plus 86 base64url chars.
Final base64url char sets a trailing pad bit; strict decoders reject it before any crypto.
No signature field; the check cannot be performed.
Signature field present but JSON null; treated like an absent signature in every runtime.
options.signatureField is the empty string; rejected before any other check except envelope shape.
A body string holds an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate (\ud800 in the file); it has no NFC or UTF-8 form, so every runtime rejects it before any crypto.
Public key string lacks the ed25519-pub: prefix.
RevocationList with quorum_signatures present; signature verifies with both signature and quorum_signatures omitted.
A quorum entry signs the same bytes as the primary signature; verified via an explicit signatureField on a synthetic view.
Applicable list does not name the key.
Key revoked before the query instant.
List applicable but its entry takes effect after the query instant.
Query instant precedes valid_from; no list applies.
Query instant equals valid_until (exclusive bound); no list applies.
Two applicable lists revoke the key; the most recent issued_at supplies list_id, revoked_at and reason.
A list failing shape validation is ignored and reported; the valid list still answers.
at carries a +02:00 offset instead of Z; no lookup is performed and the typed at_invalid result is returned.
issued_at 2026-13-40T99:99:99Z matches the schema pattern but is not an instant; that list is shape-invalid, the valid list answers.
revoked_at 2027-02-29 does not exist (2027 is not a leap year); the list is shape-invalid.
at 2027-02-29T00:00:00Z is not a real date.
at 2028-02-29T00:00:00Z exists (2028 is a leap year).
Second 60 is rejected (leap seconds are not instants in this library).
Lower year bound 0001 is accepted; no list applies that early.
Year 0000 is outside 0001..9999.
Upper year bound 9999 is accepted.
revoked_at ".5Z" equals at ".500Z"; comparison is on the instant, not the text, and is inclusive.
